ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a purple L-shaped right-angled figure. The top horizontal side is labeled 21 ft, the right vertical side is labeled 9 ft, the total height on the left is labeled 16 ft, the small horizontal side on the lower left is labeled 6 ft, and the inner vertical side is labeled 7 ft. The figure can be regarded as being composed of an upper rectangle and a vertical rectangle on the lower left, and the two parts do not overlap. Reasoning: According to the specified method, divide the figure into two rectangles. The upper rectangle has length 21 ft and height 9 ft, with area 21 × 9 = 189 square feet. The lower-left rectangle has width 6 ft and height 7 ft, with area 6 × 7 = 42 square feet. The total area is 189 + 42 = 231 square feet. Rounded to the nearest tenth, it is still 231.0.
